intro: Find the Lost Guards is an investigation tasked by Guard Thomas at the eastern bridge in Elwynn Forest. Dispatched to patrol the riverbanks against encroaching murlocs, guards Rolf and Malakai have gone missing, leaving Thomas in desperate need of confirmation on their fates.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A few days ago we sent two Guards, Rolf and Malakai, to investigate along the river, and they have not yet returned. To complete my report, I must know what happened to those men.
Travel north along the river and find the guards... Or their remains.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
